name: Stackless BVH Traversal
definition: A ray traversal algorithm for Axis-Aligned Bounding Box (AABB) hierarchies that avoids explicit stack allocation by using a linear pointer-based approach, suitable for GPU execution where stack depth is limited or unavailable.
summary: Stackless BVH Traversal is a GPU-friendly ray traversal algorithm that eliminates explicit stack allocation by encoding traversal order within a linear array of nodes.
